cc-pp.label: Seasons in which LSG scored faster than the IPL in the powerplay
cc-pp.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cc-pp.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

cc-ppn.label: LSG seasons in the series
cc-ppn.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cc-ppn.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

cc-de.label: Seasons in which LSG conceded less than the IPL in the death overs
cc-de.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cc-de.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (13) THEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

cc-series.label: LSG powerplay run rate vs IPL by season
cc-series.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cc-series.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year
